source: Quackles process/fidelity-zoom/REPORT.md (2026-10-15), sections 1, 3, 5 and 7. Transcribed; the raw object, material and texture audits behind these medians stay in the artifact store.

pyramids.family: 1 GP level zero, each of 5 themes

policy: Production admits only legacy Blue. Day is a candidate; White, Dark and Night are disabled. The five-theme 1 GP family is labelled 'not scene-matched'.

coverage.note: share of evaluated cells with at least one reachable image below 1 texel per pixel; a conservative warning, not the share of the scene proven blurry

coupons.what: 128x96 source patch traced into four colour layers, an editable SVG and a 4096x3072 atlas
coupons.note: sharper contours, but tracing also makes misshapen source glyphs sharply misshapen

coupons.what: object-space dot lattice, 0.625 mm period, over the carved shader
coupons.note: crisp dots, too uniform to count as a finished comic treatment

coupons.what: image-driven colour and micro-bump replaced with metric noise and a 25 um bump
coupons.note: one sharpness score falls to a quarter while another rises by a quarter on the same crop

render_cost_note: 32 samples, denoised, compositor off, shared RTX 3080 Ti. Full-frame numbers are pixel-linear extrapolations, not completed renders.
